Title: Magnets in a Tube — Part 2
Content: The students plan to drop each of the other magnets into the tube, `text(one)` at a time, with the `text(north)` poles facing down. The students `text(first)` drop the `text(10g)` magnet into the tube, and it falls, slows down, and then comes to a rest before it touches the other magnet in the tube. Figure `2` shows the results of the test with the `text(10g)` magnet.
